}}'''Siedre''' was a [[Da'shain Aiel]] woman who lived during the [[Breaking of the World]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Siedre|comp}}  She was the wife of [[Adan]], and an ancestor of [[Rand al'Thor]]. 

== Appearance ==
She had red-gold hair.

== History ==
Siedre was killed when the wagons of the [[Da'shain Aiel]] were attacked, apparently near the [[Mountains of Mist]].{{ref/book|4|26}} She and Adan had five children: [[Rhea]], who was kidnapped by the same bandits that killed Siedre, and [[Marind]], a son who had been killed by the first arrow that same morning; [[Sorelle]], a [[Dreamwalker]], who dreamed of her own death by fever at age twenty; [[Jaren]], who discovered he could [[channel]] at age nineteen and subsequently threw himself off a cliff; and [[Elwin]], who died of hunger at age ten. Siedre also had two grandchildren through her son Marind: [[Maigran]] and [[Lewin]].
{{Ancestry/Rand}}

==Errata==
She is listed as [[Jenn Aiel]] in [[The Wheel of Time Companion]], but the term Jenn did not exist until decades after her death. She should be Da'shain Aiel.{{ref||comp}}
